name: Joachim Streit - Après le § 21 - Am 13
title: REPORT on the financial activities of the European Investment Bank Group – annual report 2025
part_text: 21a. Stresses that EIB financing in the defence and security sector must fully respect Member States’ sovereignty over their defence procurement decisions and national defence industrial strategies; considers that EIB support for defence must prioritise the reinforcement of European industrial sovereignty, the reduction of strategic dependencies and the strengthening of national defence industrial bases;
